crossRefs.note: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting…
For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that…
Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind…
I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

translations.web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
translations.bsb: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
translations.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
translations.asv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness.
